info.description: Generated from docs/api-contracts.md — one folder per resource, one request per route, grouped to match that page's tables. Auth: {{base_url}} should be e.g. http://localhost:3210/Infer/api; {{token}} is a JWT for Authorization: Bearer, or an API key for the two Inference routes using api-key/model-id headers. Base-CRUD save/savemulti/getdata/getdatabyid bodies are generic placeholders — see the matching *.dto.ts file per resource for exact fields. Bodies are not pre-encrypted; ENABLE_ENCRYPTION is on by default server-side (see docs/api-contracts.md).
